from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

current_header = ""
current_seq = ""
for line in res.splitlines():

        if current_seq:

            print(f"{current_header}: {len(current_seq)} aa, {anal.molecular_weight()/1000.0:.2f} kDa")
